content.value: A two-dimensional array is an array of row arrays. Access an element with grid[row][column]. grid.length counts rows, and grid[row].length counts entries in that row. For a rectangular grid, total elements equal rows times columns. New int cells begin at zero; reference cells begin at null.
The output is 2, 3, and 12. Row 1 is the second row and column 2 is its third element. Using the number of rows as every column bound fails when row and column counts differ.
Practice: trace the example by hand, change one input, and explain how the result changes. Check an empty or boundary case when the preconditions allow it.
